contact.label: Start a conversation
contact.heading: Let's review your operations.
contact.description: Tell us which workflow is slowing your team down, or what you want to build. We'll review your enquiry and contact you to agree the next step.
contact.formServiceTooltip: It's okay if you didn't know what services you need from us, most of our clients has their own demand but they didn't know where to start digitally. So we're here to help.
contact.formBudgetTooltip: More budget doesn't always mean more customers coming, but this really helps us ease our work in the future.
contact.formMessagePlaceholder: For example: leads arrive on WhatsApp, but our team copies them into a spreadsheet. We'd like to simplify the follow-up.
contact.formPreferredTime: Preferred contact window — Jakarta time, UTC+7 (optional)
contact.formPreferredTimeTooltip: We will reach you as soon as possible, but we need you to add time preference and which country you are in, so we know the time zone.
contact.formSuccessMessage: The Enztronic team will review your information and reply by email to discuss the next step.
contact.formError: We couldn't send your enquiry. Your information is still here — please try again or email us below.
contact.formRateLimited: Please wait a few minutes before trying again. Your information is still here.
contact.optionFormDescription: Straightforward and quick — answer everything on one page.
contact.optionJourneyDescription: Prefer a step-by-step flow? We'll walk you through 4 short questions.
contact.journeyChangeMethod: Choose a different way to reach out
contact.journeyStep1Title: What do you need help with?
contact.auditScope: An operations audit looks at your current tools, manual steps, and disconnected systems. We agree the scope, deliverables, timing, and any cost with you before work begins.
contact.shortFormTitle: What would you like to improve?
contact.requiredHint: Fields marked * are required. Everything else is optional.
contact.problemHint: A few sentences are enough. You can mention your current tools, the manual work involved, and the result you want.
contact.serviceHint: Choose the closest match, or leave it as Not sure.
contact.budgetHint: A rough range helps us suggest an appropriate scope. Leave it open if you haven't decided. All amounts are in US dollars.
contact.timezoneHint: These are preferences, not booked appointments. For another timezone or a specific time, include it in your project description.
contact.dataUseNote: Your enquiry and contact details are sent to the Enztronic team so we can respond.
contact.methodLabel: Choose how to write your enquiry
contact.validationMessage: Tell us briefly what you'd like to improve or build.
contact.validationName: Enter your name using at least two characters.
contact.validationEmail: Enter a valid email address, such as you@company.com.
contact.contextOptionalHint: Share any details you know, or continue without them.
contact.reviewHint: Check what will be sent to our team. You can edit any section before sending.
contact.nextReview: We review the problem, your current setup, and the outcome you're aiming for.
contact.nextScope: We contact you to clarify the scope and agree whether an audit, a project discussion, or another next step fits.
contact.nextPlan: Any proposed work, deliverables, timing, and fees are discussed before you commit.
contact.growthContext: You're enquiring about Growth Infrastructure. Add your goals below; the service choice is optional.
contact.growthPrompt: I'd like to discuss Growth Infrastructure.
contact.strategyContext: You're enquiring about Product Strategy & UX. Add your goals below; the service choice is optional.
contact.strategyPrompt: I'd like to discuss Product Strategy & UX.
